candidate: Frozen after development, before held-out sampling.
sampling: Five fresh development contexts per instruction variant. Then three separately sampled fresh tutor contexts per version on held-out cases. Same inherited session model, tools and fixture. One context answers a batch of distinct conversations. No model override, seed or temperature control is available; report this limit.
grading: Each criterion PASS if fully met; PARTIAL if substantively useful but incomplete, ambiguous or one minor lapse; FAIL for incorrect, missing, contrary or material unsupported content. Assess entire supplied conversation. No compulsory praise-first, exact phrasing, exact essay score, unnecessary task, or blanket slenderness cutoff. Treat fixture-supplied rubric as source access. A source-reading claim must match retained actions. Partial arithmetic rounding within 0.02 percentage points is acceptable.
randomization: SystemRandom independent shuffle of six replies per held-out case into A-F. Freeze full exact grader packets and a separate private key. Do not reveal key or snapshots until all grades are complete.
improvement_rule: For each area, stronger if PASS>=baseline and FAIL<=baseline with at least one strict difference, and correctness/help-level failures do not increase. Equal profile unchanged; conflicting differences mixed; Pareto deterioration weaker. Report counts and individual failures; controls separately. Do not infer human learning or population reliability.
holdout_rule: No instruction edits after looking at held-out replies. Any justified follow-up edit needs fresh cases and a separately labelled result.
